common_definitions.history: All stored nhl_player_box rows for the player with game_date STRICTLY BEFORE the target game date, all seasons, ordered by game_date ASC; stat value non-null (goalies: saves non-null AND shots_against > 0). n = number of such rows.
common_definitions.base_lambda: lambda0 = shrinkageFive(values, k=8) = (n5*mean(last5) + 8*mean(all prior)) / (n5 + 8), n5 = min(5, n)  [lib/nhlProjectionEngine.js, unchanged]
common_definitions.team_game_table: Per (game_id, team): sf = SUM(skater shots_on_goal), sv = SUM(goalie saves); sa = the OTHER team's sf in the same game; only games with exactly two team rows. Derived from nhl_player_box ONLY (no nhl_team_box).
common_definitions.league_avg: L(D) = mean(sf) over ALL team-games dated strictly before D; unavailable (null) if fewer than 200 team-games.
common_definitions.opponent_context: For opponent team O at date D: O's team-games dated strictly before D; unavailable if fewer than 10. sa15 = mean(sa) of the last <=15 of them; sf15 = mean(sf) of the last <=15 of them.
common_definitions.r_allowed: r_allowed = sa15(O) / L(D)  (opponent shots-allowed environment); null if either input unavailable
common_definitions.r_offense: r_offense = sf15(O) / L(D)  (opponent shots-for environment); null if either input unavailable
common_definitions.mu_pos: mean of the SAME stat over ALL skater player-games (any player, any season) dated strictly before D within the target player's position group; null if fewer than 2000 such rows
common_definitions.mu_goalie: mean saves over ALL goalie appearances (saves non-null, shots_against > 0) dated strictly before D; null if fewer than 200 such rows
common_definitions.eb: eb(lambda, n, mu, K) = (n*lambda + K*mu) / (n + K); if mu is null or K == 0 returns lambda unchanged
common_definitions.opp: opp(lambda, r, g) = lambda * (1 + g*(r - 1)); if r is null or g == 0 returns lambda unchanged
common_definitions.edge: Edge = projection - providerLine for SOG and Saves only, exactly as in production; no edge for binary families (unchanged)

minimum_history_games.note: unchanged production gates; denominators identical to production

fallback_behavior: If ANY candidate input is unavailable for a game (opponent <10 prior games, league <200 team-games, prior pool too small), that input's adjustment is skipped and the production value for that component is used; no game is dropped. If all adjustments are skipped the output equals production exactly.

goalie_saves.formula: lambda1 = eb(lambda0, n, mu_goalie, K1);  projection = opp(lambda1, r_offense, g3)
goalie_saves.train_selection: K1 in {0,10,20,40,80,160,320}; g3 in {0,0.5,1.0}; structure best-of(V2,V3,V4) = V3 by TRAIN MAE

goals_at_least_1.formula: lambda = eb(lambda0, n, mu_pos, K);  P = 1 - exp(-lambda)

assists_at_least_1.formula: lambda = eb(lambda0, n, mu_pos, K);  P = 1 - exp(-lambda)

points_at_least_1.formula: lambda = opp(eb(lambda0, n, mu_pos, K), r_allowed, g);  P = 1 - exp(-lambda)
points_at_least_1.train_selection: K grid as above; g in {0,0.5,1.0}; best TRAIN Brier
points_at_least_1.note: marginal: passes the 0.5% bar by 0.034 pt; the simpler eb-only variant (B2) did NOT pass (-0.32%)

shots_on_goal: S2 EB position prior (TRAIN chose K=0 -> identical to production)

holdout_protocol_PREREGISTERED.retuning_after_opening: FORBIDDEN -- every parameter above is final; a failing family stays on production and is not re-tuned or re-specified
holdout_protocol_PREREGISTERED.data: season=2026 rows only for outcomes (history for features includes all earlier stored games, strictly as-of); same eligibility gates and denominators as production
holdout_protocol_PREREGISTERED.inference: paired per-row loss difference vs production, SE clustered by game date; Bonferroni across the 5 families -> two-sided 99% CI (z=2.576)
holdout_protocol_PREREGISTERED.pass_rule: PASS iff 99% CI upper bound < 0 AND relative improvement <= -0.25% (half the promotion bar) AND (binary) ECE not worse by more than 0.005 AND (continuous) |bias| not worse by more than 0.05*mean(actual)
